verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a Railway CLI, an MCP server and agent skills, but none of it describes a documented public API (REST, GraphQL or otherwise) that a user can call directly. Probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The CLI and MCP evidence belongs to separate stories and does not transfer to this one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
